name: Bareface Esthetics
address: 1500 Elizabeth Avenue Suite 23 (at Sola Salon Studios), West Palm Beach, FL 33401
email_source: Publicly listed on business directory listings (Yelp business info aggregation, guidetoflorida.com) cross-checked across multiple independent sources; not confirmed by directly opening a Bareface-controlled page, so treat as high-confidence but secondary-sourced
review_source: Birdeye aggregated reviews page (reviews.birdeye.com/bareface-esthetics-llc-170023102082821), cross-referenced with Yelp listing (22 photos, same address 1500 Elizabeth Ave)
own_site_check: barefaceesthetics.com, barefaceestheticsfl.com, barefaceestheticsllc.com, bareface-esthetics.com, barefaceestheticsflorida.com all fail to resolve (DNS/connect failure). Only public link is the GlossGenius booking subdomain. NOTE: a DIFFERENT business with a similar name, 'BareFace Aesthetics' (2161 Palm Beach Lakes Blvd, WPB, 4.9 rating / 169 reviews) DOES have its own site at barefaceaesthetic.com -- confirmed as a separate business (different address, different owner 'Nicole', different phone 561-810-0555) and NOT the one built here.
about: At Bareface Esthetics, the goal is to help you feel comfortable, confident, and radiant in your own skin. Founded by Rebecca Valenti, a Licensed Esthetician, as a space where results-driven skincare is approached realistically and intentionally. The practice blends clinical knowledge with a holistic approach, customizing each facial to the client's skin and lifestyle.

reviews.author: Amanda Slis
reviews.text: Her treatments are above and beyond amazing. I can't recommend enough.

reviews.author: Elise Lessans
reviews.text: The absolute best facial ever!!!!! Rebecca is knowledgeable and professional. Love her products.

reviews.author: Penny Silver
reviews.text: Rebecca is so gentle and customized my treatment for my skin. Totally recommend her.

reviews.author: Danny Garcia
reviews.text: She created such a relaxing atmosphere, and you can really feel her great energy as soon as you walk in.

reviews.author: Tanya Smith
reviews.text: My skin has never looked so good. I look forward to my appointments with her.

services_source: https://barefaceestheticsfl.glossgenius.com/services (extracted via WebFetch, prices and durations exact as published)
photos_notes: 12 photos downloaded from the public Instagram feed via scripts/ig_photos.py. 5 were promotional graphic cards with text overlay (holiday post, seasonal facial ad, microneedling quote card, before/after collage) and were excluded from the gallery. 4 of the remaining 7 real treatment photos had a small 'Before' watermark in a corner from an Instagram before/after template; these were cropped with PIL to remove the watermark before use. All images resized to max 1000px width. A separate attempt via scripts/glossgenius_dossier.py (used only to extract the services menu) returned mostly generic stock photography for this business and was NOT used for the gallery, per the pipeline warning that GlossGenius photos are often stock.

build.palette: custom warm clay/dusty-rose light palette derived from the brand's warm skin-tone photography (accent-deep #b1626a, accent-mid #c98f8f, bg #faf3f0, ink #3a2622)
build.bilingual: data-es/data-en added throughout (not present in the base template copied); English default per detected business language
build.gate: python3 scripts/gate.py bareface-esthetics-wpb --lang en --forbid "Amani,Flagami,HeadSpa,Unwinding,Mizu,Hialeah" -> GATE OK

discovery.method: Google web search for 'facial studio Boca Raton / med spa West Palm Beach / facial studio Port St Lucie' plus GlossGenius directory search for estheticians in West Palm Beach and Boca Raton
